scope.change: PIO data movement replaced with word-addressed IDMA through a coherent bounce buffer

dma.scatter_gather: Linux SG copied via sg_copy_to/from_buffer; no streaming mapping or virtual-to-physical cast
dma.ordering: dma_wmb before enabling engine; MMIO status then dma_rmb before reading ownership/results
dma.descriptor_length_reference: A733 Table11-6: SMHC3 bits11:0; zero skips buffer. 1KiB is below both manual12-bit and conservative Tina11-bit configuration.
dma.descriptor_flags: Only OWN31/FD3/LD2; old SMHC0-2 CH/DIC/ER/CES bits are reserved on SMHC3 and never written/interpreted.

controller_writes: CTRL DMA enable and FIFO/DMA interface reset
FIFOTHRESHOLD 0x300f00f0 (SMHC3 MBUS outstanding encoding3, RX15, TX240)
DMAC reset bit0 / enable bit7 only; reserved bit1 not written
register_scope.inherited_v16_writes: command, response lifecycle, width, reset, 24MHz clock divider and legacy timing unchanged

completion: directional IDST TX/RX done (may occur per descriptor)
OWN clear in every used descriptor
IDMA/FIFO reset acknowledged before results copied or allocation reused
failure_handling: DMA/controller errors return zero bytes transferred; RINT bit13 is read-start error or normal write-busy clear; bits8/9/10/18 are timeouts in this fixed legacy host.
Every data request stops and resets DMA before completion
Existing explicit CMD12 error recovery retained unless engine is quarantined
A reset timeout poisons host I/O and retains both coherent allocations until reboot; unsafe memory is neither reused nor freed

validation.host: Actual SMHC3 descriptor/completion C compiled with gcc -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsanitize=address,undefined. Passed reserved bits zero, low4G boundaries, alignment/overflow, all-descriptor ownership, command/data/directional completion, write busy-clear vs read-start-error, timeout and error precedence.
validation.kernel: Image, DTB and modules built in independent source/output; config differs only by localversion
validation.package: Debian control fields, config, decompressed kernel and DTB matched to final output hashes
validation.board: pending, parent agent exclusively handles board

board_acceptance: Keep v16 boot option and matching v16 PVR for rollback
Install candidate with freshly compiled v18 PVR module
Verify SMCV, gate read-only values, low4G allocation logs and first IDMA request completion
Check rootfs mount, journal/dmesg for MMC timeout/CRC/DMA errors
Compare bounded scratch-file write/read SHA256, repeated cached-vs-direct sequential throughput and CPU use against v16
Reboot/cold boot and recheck successful filesystem/GPU/desktop operation before promotion
next_modes: HS52: implement verified parent/mux/divisor and MMC high-speed timing at conservative steps; retain physical 1.8V board rail and check errors
HS200: add explicit 1.8V capability/ios semantics, CMD21 tuning scan and valid-window center selection with retuning support
HS400: require successful HS200 pre-tuning plus DDR mode, strobe delay/HS400 transition and integrity/temperature evidence; no frequency-only enable

address_correction.reason: Those omitted CCU base +0x2000 and were PIO-range reads. Their zero values are invalid gate evidence. Correct CCU base is 0x02002000.
address_correction.gate_write_draft: Removed before final build; no board writes ever performed by this agent

media_state: v17 stage2 remains unaccepted and undeployed; per-domain coherent IOMMU draft remains unintegrated and uncompiled; Cedar v2 has gst-inspect acceptance only. Media work paused for storage priority.

manual_specialization.correction: Tina common descriptor/IDMA definitions include old SMHC0-2 bits. Final driver follows SMHC3 manual and independently reviewed direction-specific status semantics.

topology_preserved.note: Initial build is DMA-only. Second command reconstructs and structurally verifies the accepted topology without rebuilding Image/PVR.
